About Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd

Headquartered near Basel, Switzerland – a European biotech hub – Idorsia has a highly experienced team of dedicated professionals, covering all disciplines from bench to bedside; QUVIVIQ™ (daridorexant), a different kind of insomnia treatment with the potential to revolutionize this mounting public health concern; strong partners to maximize the value of our portfolio; a promising in-house development pipeline; and a specialized drug discovery engine focused on small-molecule drugs that can change the treatment paradigm for many patients.

We are looking for the Head of Global Supply Chain to join our company !

Job Responsibilities

The Head of Global Supply Chain leads the design and execution of an end-to-end global supply chain across Development, Manufacturing, and Commercial Operations.

The role oversees planning (IBP/S&OP), external manufacturing and sourcing, logistics and distribution, and master data, ensuring a scalable, agile, and compliant supply chain.

Working cross-functionally, the VP drives forecasting, supports product launches, optimizes financial flows, and builds a high-performing team, combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a dynamic environment.

• Design, implement, and lead an end-to-end Global Supply Chain organization , covering planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution.

• Define and execute a scalable, agile, and digital supply chain strategy supporting both product launches and long-term growth.

• Establish and lead Integrated Business Planning (IBP) / Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes to align demand, supply, and financial plans.

• Develop and implement best-in-class forecasting models and systems , ensuring accuracy and alignment with commercial and R&D pipelines.

• Oversee external manufacturing and sourcing activities (drug substance and drug product), ensuring supply reliability, quality, and cost efficiency.

• Design and optimize global logistics and distribution networks across US, EU, and Asia, including warehousing and transportation strategies.

• Define and manage country-specific distribution models and select/oversee third-party partners (CMOs, wholesalers, logistics providers).

• Ensure full GDP compliance and adherence to all applicable regulatory and quality standards across the supply chain.

• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global supply chain team , fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Drive operational excellence initiatives , including process standardization, lean practices, and performance management.

• Lead new product introduction (NPI) supply readiness in close collaboration with R&D, Regulatory, and Commercial teams.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Commercial, Finance, Tax, HR, Market Access, and R&D to ensure alignment on forecasts, supply plans, and financial flows.

• Manage key relationships with external partners and stakeholders , including CMOs, distributors, and governmental bodies.

• Own and manage the Global Supply Chain budget , including planning, sourcing, logistics, and operational costs.

• Monitor market demand and supply performance , analyze trends, and adjust supply plans accordingly to ensure product availability.

• Lead transformation and change management initiatives within a dynamic and evolving global environment.

Candidate's Requirements

•
Bachelor’s, Master’s, or MBA in Economics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or related field

•
Fluent in English; French and/or German is an asset

•
Minimum 15+ years of experience in Supply Chain management, ideally within the Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical industry

•
Experience across primary care and specialty care supply chains, including external manufacturing models (CMOs)

•
Proven experience supporting product launches and/or development phases

•
Strong track record in building and leading supply chain teams at regional or global level

•
Experience in both large, best-in-class organizations and scaling supply chain functions in smaller or growing environments

•
Strong exposure to pan-European supply chains; experience in North America and Asia is a plus

•
Solid knowledge of manufacturing processes and GxP (GMP & GDP) requirements

•
Good understanding of regulatory frameworks, including launches, tech transfers, and supplier qualification

•
Strong expertise in forecasting and integrated supply chain planning (IBP/S&OP)

•
Strong financial and analytical skills

•
Proven project management experience with complex, cross-functional initiatives, including IT-related projects

Country: Switzerland

Business Area: Global Supply Chain - Technical Oeprations

Schedule: Fulltime

Job Type: Permanent

Job ID : 4726

About Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd

Headquartered near Basel, Switzerland – a European biotech hub – Idorsia has a highly experienced team of dedicated professionals, covering all disciplines from bench to bedside; QUVIVIQ™ (daridorexant), a different kind of insomnia treatment with the potential to revolutionize this mounting public health concern; strong partners to maximize the value of our portfolio; a promising in-house development pipeline; and a specialized drug discovery engine focused on small-molecule drugs that can change the treatment paradigm for many patients.

We are looking for a VP, Head of Global Marketing to join the company!

Job Responsibilities

The VP, Head of Global Marketing is a senior strategic leadership role responsible for defining and driving the global commercial strategy of pipeline and launch assets from Phase 2 onwards.

The role serves as the global commercial voice across the product lifecycle, ensuring that clinical development, evidence generation, market access, medical strategy, positioning, launch readiness, and lifecycle planning are fully integrated to maximize asset and portfolio value.

Working cross-functionally with Development, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Finance, Regions, and Commercial teams, the VP, Head of Global Marketing leads New Product Planning, Launch Readiness, and Global Launch Excellence while supporting executive decision-making and long-term value creation.

• Lead New Product Planning (NPP) activities across pipeline assets from Phase 2 onward.

• Define and execute global commercial strategies for development-stage and launch assets.

• Partner with Life Cycle Leaders to shape asset strategy, target indications, sequencing, evidence generation plans, and lifecycle opportunities.

• Develop asset value propositions, differentiation strategies, target product profiles, and commercial business cases.

• Assess market opportunities, competitive landscapes, patient needs, treatment pathways, and future standards of care.

• Provide commercial input into clinical development plans to ensure future market adoption, reimbursement, and differentiation.

• Build commercial forecasts, opportunity assessments, valuation scenarios, and portfolio recommendations.

• Establish and lead the global Launch Readiness framework, governance, milestones, and decision-making processes.

• Drive integrated launch planning across Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance, Regions, and Affiliates.

• Identify launch-critical risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to ensure successful execution.

• Define and monitor launch readiness metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and performance indicators.

• Serve as Global Launch Lead for selected strategic assets from late-stage development through launch and early commercialization.

• Lead global cross-functional launch teams and coordinate launch execution across all key functions and regions.

• Develop global brand strategies, positioning, segmentation, messaging architecture, and stakeholder engagement plans.

• Translate clinical differentiation into compelling value propositions for healthcare professionals, patients, payers, and health systems.

• Partner closely with Medical Affairs and Market Access teams on scientific platforms, evidence strategies, pricing assumptions, and reimbursement plans.

• Collaborate with regional and affiliate teams to ensure globally aligned but locally adaptable launch and commercialization strategies.

• Support portfolio prioritization, launch sequencing, resource allocation, and investment decisions across the organization.

• Establish governance and operating rhythms for Global Marketing, New Product Planning, and Launch Readiness activities.

• Drive alignment between Development, Medical, Access, Commercial, and Regional organizations to ensure integrated asset strategies.

• Lead post-launch reviews, performance tracking, and lifecycle optimization initiatives.

• Build a culture of accountability, strategic thinking, execution excellence, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Advanced degree in Business, Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, or related field preferred.MBA, PharmD, MD, PhD, or equivalent experience considered an advantage.

• Minimum 15+ years of experience within Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or Healthcare.

We are offering a 12-month HR Trainee position designed for early-career professionals who are eager to gain practical experience across different areas of Human Resources.

Project & Functional Support

In addition to operational tasks, you will have the opportunity to support HR initiatives across different areas, which may evolve over time, such as:

• Contributing to projects in areas like Talent Development, Talent Acquisition, or Employee Benefits

• Assisting with research, documentation, and internal communication materials

• Participating in process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field or completed HR apprenticeship

• Motivation to learn and contribute in both operational and project-based environments

• Structured, detail-oriented, and well-organized working style

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills

• Good MS Office skills (Excel, Word, Outlook)

• You have solid academic or vocational foundation in HR
